newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian/U.S. bond yield spread blows out.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian/U.S. bond yield spread blows out.

text.p: The Australian bond yield spread to the U.S. blew out sharply after an initial local markdown following Thursday's weakness in U.S. Treasuries which saw several technical levels severed, prompting further stop loss selling.

Local yields had started slightly narrower to the dollar bloc, but this was reversed in largely futures-driven trading, although there are also concerns over how the U.S. will perform later today after two sharp sell-offs either side of the New Year holiday.
The latest U.S. move followed a jump in the December NAPM index to 54.0, and close to a level that has historically preceded a tightening in monetary policy.
The spread widening was less notable against Canadian debt, which had overshot the U.S. sell-off with the move compounded by a soft Canadian dollar.
The local yield curve steepened again with the U.S. market again weighing more heavily on the long-end.
